Advertising Team Application 

Minecraft Username: Matic0B

Discord ID: Matic0B#4502

In 1 or 2 sentences, tell me who you are: 18 year old European that finished high school (media technitian title, classes in design, marketing and video production) and is interested in games and running a business. 

What is your Planet Minecraft account? (If you do not have one, put N/A) N/A  (have one but dont use it and havent in a while)

What is your reddit account? (If you do not have one, put N/A) N/A (have one but dont use it and havent in a while)

Have you ever advertised a Minecraft server before? Former Social Relations Marketing at Lifeboat PC

If yes above, please describe of what you did and the challenges you faced. Working with people to advertise and create content for the server

What ideas/help can you bring to this team? I can bring some experience and a will to help out. Looking into ways of advertising and negotiating deals to make the ads, working on promotional materail.

How active are you/how is your work ethic? Im mostly active on Discord but not so much ingame, work when I have to and am around most of the time during the day. If something has to be done ill make sure It gets done.
